title: Welcome and Table of Contents
summary: An introduction to SS3 English Language Second Term and the list of all units: government and law vocabulary, poetry and drama, argument, adverbial and adjectival clauses, reports, letters and the play The Blood of a Stranger.

p: As you prepare for your final examinations, special vocabulary (called register) is very important. This term you study the language of government and administration and the language of law and order. You also learn to read and listen to poetry and drama, to build and follow an argument, to use adjuncts, relative clauses, adverbial clauses and complex sentences, and to write letters to the editor, reports and minutes. The term ends with a revision of the play The Blood of a Stranger.
Work through the units in order. Do the activities and check questions in each unit. The check questions do not count towards a mark but they show you what you have understood.
